axis: km values are distances along each supplied GPX route (points_json d_km), not official race kilometres; rescale to the official 42.195 km before matching timing mats.

classes.a: no structures that matter; profile usable as is
classes.b: correctable now with cited data; apply the corrections
classes.c: not verifiable in time; the band should stay even pace

method: Structures: every OSM highway way tagged bridge/tunnel/covered (or non-zero layer) lying along the route within 12 m for at least half its length; pedestrian subways and footbridges excluded; ways merged per crossing.
Base check and rebuild: national terrain models sampled every 25 m along the route after snapping the GPX line to the nearest aligned OSM road centreline, 5-sample running median, output every 50 m.
Bridge decks: surface model (DSM) 25th percentile within 1 m along the bridge way where an open DSM exists; otherwise a straight deck between the ground at both ends (flag straight_deck_assumed).
Tunnels and underpasses: straight line between the portals (flag tunnel_use_assumed) unless the race is not known to use them.
New York: NYC Planimetric Elevation Points (bridge and street spot elevations) projected onto the route.

Use: rebuilt profiles carry 0.4-1.7 m of sample noise (second-difference SD at 50 m); a grade model should use grades smoothed over at least 200 m and gain thresholds of 2 m. After that smoothing rebuilt and supplied total gains agree within about 15 m except Auckland (236 vs 115 m) and Oslo (233 vs 180 m), where the supplied 800 m smoothing removed real short hills.

Rejected sources: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM reads 0.0 m on the Verrazzano-Narrows main span (water flattened); SRTM 30 m reads 0 m at the same point (lead check); NSW 5 m elevation is NoData on the Harbour Bridge.

corrections.name: Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge, upper level, with Staten Island and Brooklyn approaches
corrections.dem_before: 40.6 m at the start, -1.6 m (water) from 0.63 to 2.08 km, 15 m at 2.4 km
corrections.evidence: Bridge-elevation points every ~60 m along the upper-level roadway: 40.3 m at the start line, 79.2 m at midspan (1.24 km), 41.8 m at the Brooklyn end of the suspended structure (2.49 km); street spot elevations 13.2 m at 3.03-3.14 km where the route is back at grade. The peak agrees with the bridge record: 228 ft (69.5 m) clearance above mean high water at midspan (Britannica; Wikipedia infobox citing Adams 1996) plus the deck structure.
corrections.notes: Upper level only. The dataset also holds a second series 10.7 m lower at midspan (68.4 m), which is below the published 69.5 m clearance and cannot be the lower roadway surface as published, so it is not used; lower-level (Green start) runners climb roughly 7-11 m less. The 2.6-3.0 km ramp descent is drawn as one straight grade between the last deck point and the first at-grade street point because two ramps lie within the GPX alignment error there; its total (41.9 to 13.2 m) is pinned.

courses.summary: Large parts of the route are on elevated expressways (East Coast Parkway 10.6-11.7 km, Ayer Rajah Expressway 30.6-31.5 and 39.1-40.5 km, West Coast Highway viaducts 32.4-38.4 km), Nicoll Highway bridges (2.6-3.2, 6.2-6.7 km). The mapzen profile has spikes to 40-55 m that are building returns. No open terrain or surface model was found.

Vasterbron (28.1-29.0 km, 960 m) reads 12.3 m mid-bridge in the DEM; the published navigation clearance is 26 m under the southern arch (Wikipedia; Structurae), so the deck crown is roughly 28-31 m and the error is about 17 m. Lantmateriet elevation data needs an account, so neither the deck profile nor the base profile could be verified. Smaller: Slussbron, Sankt Eriksbron, Vasabron, Norrbro.

The supplied profile is not usable even off structures: against 203 NSW SCIMS survey marks within 8 m of the route (NSW Spatial Services NSW_Survey_Mark MapServer, AHD71 heights) the DEM reads +19.8 m (0-1 km), +19.0 m (3-4 km), +12.8 m (9-10 km) and +34 to +50 m (12-14 km) above the marks, but -4.2 m at 6-7 km. Structures: Sydney Harbour Bridge (Bradfield Highway, 1.5-3.2 km; DEM 9.5 m mid-span; published clearance 49 m at mid-span), Western Distributor viaducts and tunnel (3.6-5.4 km), Cahill Expressway (11.1 km), Eastern Distributor tunnel (15.6-16.3 km). No open DSM was found (NSW_5M_Elevation is bare earth and NoData on the bridge).

Rebuilt from the GSI elevation service: the supplied mapzen profile reads a median 12.8 m above GSI (p95 22 m) and its 157 m of gain falls to 37 m (after the 35 m descent from Shinjuku the course is within a few metres of sea level). Sumida river bridges (Kuramaebashi twice, Kiyosumi-dori, Shin-Ohashi-dori) and the start overpasses (Tocho-dori, Gijido-dori) drawn as straight decks between the ground at both ends; short underpasses portal to portal.
